title: Technician Grade II
qualification: High School or equivalent examination from a recognized Board with Science and Mathematics, All India/State Vocational Certificate in Electrician trade, and 2 years of relevant work experience obtained after acquiring the required qualification
salary: All three Technician Grade II categories carry the same notified Level-4 pay scale.
age_limit: Candidates should have completed 18 years of age and should not have completed 42 years as on 01 July 2026. || The notification provides age relaxation according to Uttarakhand Government rules for eligible reserved categories. It mentions relaxation provisions for eligible SC, ST and OBC candidates, Persons with Disabilities, dependants of freedom fighters and eligible ex-servicemen, subject to the conditions prescribed in the notification.
application_fee: The examination fee can be paid through the online payment options provided in the application system, including Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking or UPI, as available on the portal.
